description: This source file defines the OpenmrsRevisionEntityListener class which implements Hibernate's RevisionListener to track changes and set metadata such as changers and timestamps for revisions in openmrs core, specifically within the Envers auditing framework.

classes.name: OpenmrsRevisionEntityListener
classes.description: A Hibernate revision listener used to set metadata on revision entities, such as who made the change and when.

methods.name: newRevision
methods.description: Overrides the RevisionListener's method to populate revision metadata: sets the user who made the change and timestamp.
